title: Article 51 — Promotion of international peace and security

content.overview: Article 51 directs the State to promote international peace and security, maintain just and honourable relations between nations, foster respect for international law and treaty obligations, and encourage settlement of international disputes by arbitration. Verify full clause text officially.

sections.heading: International orientation
sections.body: Article 51 situates Indian governance in a framework of international peace and respect for international law and treaties. Domestic effect of treaties remains governed by constitutional and statutory rules on incorporation.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Treaty and international-law arguments in domestic courts require the applicable incorporation or statutory hook. Article 51 is a policy directive, not a private cause of action.
